The Fierce Sea Battle'') is the eighteenth chapter of the [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] manga. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} The {{p|Magikarp}} raft can only hold a pair of children. Two {{p|Magikarp}} are not strong enough to hold the weight. {{GnB|Chris}} says that it is unsafe and {{GnB|Gold}} agrees. A man lends his {{p|Remoraid}} to help them. Gold and Chris try to get away from a group of {{p|Tentacruel}}, but a couple of Magikarp are not fast enough to help them get away. {{TP|Gold|Croconaw}} and {{p|Wooper}} are brought out to help. Gold and Chris almost crash into some {{p|Horsea}}. They also see {{p|Staryu}} and {{p|Seaking}}. The Magikarp become tired. Gold and Chris see {{tc|Executive|Rocket Executive}} {{GnB|Grey}} who also recognizes them. Gold wonders how they got to find the area. The raft breaks. Gold and Chris are threatened by a whirlpool.
